values.draft: The Gucci Oversized Cat-Eye, in Ivory / Brown gradient. The cat-eye lifts the outer corner of the eye and draws attention upwards, which is why it flatters most face shapes. This size measures 56mm across each lens. The lenses block 100% of UV as the brand supplies them, and I can swap in polarised if you would rather. Prescription lenses go in this frame without any trouble — single vision or var
